description: Reusable .NET library for enforcing architecture and code quality rules via configurable, extensible rule engine.
releaseNotes:
# Release Notes
    ## 1.0.0 - 2025-10-17
    - Initial set of architecture/code quality rules:
    - Layering rule: Enforces correct layering between project components.
    - Forbidden Dependencies rule: Flags forbidden project or assembly dependencies.
    - Naming Conventions rule: Enforces naming conventions for classes, methods, etc.
    - No Circular Dependencies rule: Detects circular references between projects or namespaces.
    - Allowed Layer Dependencies rule: Restricts which layers can depend on which.
    - No Direct Forbidden Types rule: Flags direct usage of forbidden types.
    - No Public Fields in Domain rule: Flags public fields in domain model classes.
    - Method Naming rule: Enforces method naming patterns and conventions.
    - Unqualified Type Usage rule: Flags usage of types without namespace qualification.
    - Max Class Lines rule: Warns if a class exceeds a configurable number of lines.
    - Max Function Lines rule: Warns if a function/method exceeds a configurable number of lines.

    ## 1.0.1 - 2025-10-22
    - Improved method naming rule messages for clarity.
    - Excludes property accessors and async state machine methods from naming checks.
    - Added support for user-friendly violation messages including class and namespace.
    - Improved to find class name
    - Added 20 new architecture/code quality rules:
    - Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) rule: Warns if a class has too many methods.
    - Interface Segregation rule: Warns if interfaces are too large or not implemented.
    - Dependency Inversion rule: Flags direct dependencies from high-level to low-level modules.
    - Immutability rule: Flags public setters or mutable collections in domain entities.
    - No Magic Numbers rule: Detects hardcoded numeric literals (except 0, 1, -1).
    - No TODO/FIXME Comments rule: Warns if code contains TODO or FIXME comments.
    - No Dead Code rule: Flags unused private methods, fields, or classes.
    - No Synchronous Calls in Async Methods rule: Warns if Task.Wait(), .Result, etc. are used in async methods.
    - No Blocking Calls in UI Layer rule: Flags blocking calls (e.g., Thread.Sleep) in UI code.
    - No Use of Obsolete APIs rule: Flags usage of [Obsolete] APIs.
    - No Large Files rule: Warns if a file exceeds a configurable number of lines.
    - No Large Parameter Lists rule: Flags methods with too many parameters.
    - No Nested Classes rule: Warns if classes are nested more than one level deep.
    - No Static State rule: Flags static mutable fields (except constants).
    - No Direct Instantiation of Certain Types rule: Flags direct instantiation of types that should use DI.
    - No Use of Dynamic rule: Flags usage of the dynamic keyword.
    - No Use of Regions rule: Flags #region/#endregion usage in code.
    - Consistent Naming for Test Methods rule: Enforces a naming pattern for test methods.
    - No Public Fields rule: Flags public fields in classes.
    - No Use of var for Non-Obvious Types rule: Flags var usage for non-obvious types.
